summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark, including the removal of Spark 3.4 support and adapting to Spark's new quarterly release cadence. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about schema evolution policies, REST specification modifications, and upcoming patch releases for versions 1.11.1 and 1.10.3.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration updates with Spark.
Discussion on porting Java 17 features to Iceberg core for upcoming release.
Need for write-side path management during schema evolution discussed.
Modifications to REST spec for passing properties to request signers proposed.
